name: frog_trill
character: A treefrog chorus on a warm night: short pulsed trills, faster when the air is warmer.
sources: Gerhardt & Doherty (1988) as cited in Diekamp & Gerhardt (1995), J. Comp. Physiol. A: in Hyla versicolor the pulse rate rises linearly with temperature, 13 to 32 pulses per second between 13 and 26 C (about 6 percent per degree around 20 C, the rate_per_c here)
ESTIMATE: carrier frequency, call length and call rate are typical treefrog values, not measured
